set.body:
Scope

Evolve EventModel and its metadata rather than introducing a parallel CompiledDesign stack. The compiled matrix and its scientific schema must have one authority.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Define a closed structural column-origin algebra covering event/task, trial, sampled covariate or nuisance, intercept, drift, and other supported baseline columns.
- [ ] Event origins retain TermId, optional phase identity, structural CellKey assignments, optional modulator identity, basis element identity/role, column role, and run scope.
- [ ] CellKey stores typed factor-to-level assignments and never requires parsing an encoded condition string.
- [ ] Each realized column has a stable ColumnId, ordinal, structural origin, and rendered label; labels are derived presentation data.
- [ ] A RowLayout records run/block identity, acquisition rows/times, and any selected/censored alignment needed to bind responses safely.
- [ ] Matrix column count equals schema cardinality, rows equal RowLayout cardinality, IDs are unique, and invalid combinations return typed DesignError values.
- [ ] DesignAudit subsumes current diagnostics and records event counts, excluded/out-of-range events, empty cells, missing-value resolutions, centering/scaling receipts, and rank preview evidence.
- [ ] DesignFingerprint has a documented canonical encoding and is deterministic on JVM and Scala.js; relevant semantic, row-layout, policy, or matrix changes alter it.
- [ ] Existing columnNames, spans, indices, DesignColmap, and export surfaces are derived compatibility views over the canonical schema.
- [ ] The authoritative path does not parse rendered basis suffixes or condition labels; any legacy fallback is isolated, named, and tested.
- [ ] Existing design tests plus new schema invariant and fingerprint tests pass on both platforms.
set.title: P1.1: make compiled design columns, row layout, fingerprint, and audit canonical
